description: This file defines the 'RecipeService' class responsible for managing recipe data, including loading sample recipes, handling user favorites, and managing custom recipes via shared preferences in a Flutter application.

classes.name: RecipeService
classes.description: Service class to handle recipe data, local storage interactions, and in-memory catalog.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads the complete set of recipes, favorites, and custom recipes from local storage, merging favorite status.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Adds or removes a recipe ID from the favorites stored in local storage.

methods.name: saveCustomRecipe
methods.description: Saves or updates a custom recipe in local storage.

methods.name: deleteCustomRecipe
methods.description: Deletes a custom recipe and removes it from favorites if present.
